### The Cry of the Martyrs
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-cry-of-the-martyrs
Passage: Revelation 6:9-11
Points:
- Earthly death does not sever the living, intimate relationship between Christ and His people.
- The suffering and martyrdom of faithful witnesses serve an appointed purpose in God's plan to reach the nations.
- God has not overlooked the persecution of His saints and will bring complete justice in His timing.
- While divine vindication can seem delayed to sufferers, history is moving precisely according to the Lord's sovereign decree.

### How Do We Rest in the Face of Horrible Calamity?
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/how-do-we-rest-in-the-face-of-horrible-calamity
Passage: Revelation 6:11
Points:
- Heaven's martyrs are instructed to enter soul-refreshing rest rather than remain gripped by urgency for immediate vengeance.
- Their rest is grounded in God's sovereignty over the exact, appointed number of fellow servants who must suffer.
- Supernatural emotional calm during great affliction is rooted in total trust in God's wisdom and goodness.
- Resting in Christ amid ongoing tragedy is not uncaring apathy, but a quiet, tear-filled repose upon Him.
